sentences.en: Send this parcel to him in care of his company.
sentences.zh: 把这份包裹寄给他，并请转交给他的公司。

sentences.en: I'd like to send this parcel to Japan by sea.
sentences.zh: 我想通过海运把这个包裹寄到日本。

sentences.en: Frankie parceled out soup for each of the homeless men.
sentences.zh: 弗兰基给每个无家可归的男人分发汤。

senses.zh: 包裹，小包；一块地，一片土地
